# survHEhmc 0.0.12

## November 2026

* `make_data_stan()`: for the Royston-Parmar model (`distr="rps"`), gives a warning when `fit.models()` is called with `scale` other than `"hazard"` or `timescale` other than `"log"`. The Stan model `RP.stan` is only implemented on the hazard scale with log time; thus, these options were previously ignored without notice (see also [survHE PR #75](https://github.com/giabaio/survHE/pull/75)).

# survHEhmc 0.0.11

## October 2026

* Fix an issue generated by the `colnames()` for the `data.stan` matrix `X`. When there are no covariates in the model formula, this would break the `make_data_stan()` utility function and then `fit.models()`.

## July 2025

* Adds `colnames()` to the `data.stan` matrix `X`

* Adds `onload()` message with version of the package

* Re-creates `NAMESPACE` using `Roxygen`

## March 2025

* Added a `NEWS.md` file to track changes to the package.
